title: Founding Team Planning Session
summary: The first working session for founders and students interested in leadership, projects, outreach, and the Fall launch.
description: We will confirm responsibilities, review the charter process, prepare for tabling, and decide the first public meeting and project priorities.
location: Oberlin College · Room to be announced

title: Meet the Society at Fall Tabling
summary: Meet the founding team, explore the project board, and find your place in Oberlin's engineering community.
description: Students can join the mailing list, express leadership interest, volunteer for projects, and register for the kickoff event.

title: Engineering Kickoff + Pizza Night
summary: The first all-community gathering for engineering-minded students across departments and class years.
description: Meet collaborators, hear the society's plan, explore the 3-2 pathway, pitch project ideas, and choose how you want to participate.
location: Oberlin College · Room to be announced

title: 3-2 Pathways Panel
summary: A practical conversation about planning, partner schools, transitions, engineering fields, and the questions students should ask early.
description: The panel will bring together program knowledge, student perspective, and alumni experience in one useful session.

title: Project Pitch Night
summary: Bring a problem, a rough idea, or a skill you want to use. Leave with a team and a sharper project brief.
description: Teams will form around achievable problems, define users and impact, identify technical needs, and prepare for design review.

title: Future Oberlin Engineering Challenge
summary: A developing concept for a public build challenge and interdisciplinary project showcase.
description: The society is exploring a format that could move teams from problem framing to prototype, testing, documentation, and a public technical explanation. No date, venue, awards, or official rules are confirmed.
date_label: Future concept · Date to be announced
